title: Stuart's failed demo anchor can only be re-sent from his side. Tell him how?
bluf: Seat AA 8th measured demo-pk read-only (nothing written). Both of Stuart's conditions hold: the KS-2196 fix is running in demo's anchoring (three independent checks), and anchor_c3d42601 is failed, untouched since 13 Nov, with NOTHING landed on chain (two instruments, with a control). But there is no requeue route: the only way to re-arm it is the same call Platform S makes (POST /api/anchors, same document and content hash), which needs a caller that owns the document's tenant, i.e. Stuart's connector key. We hold no such credential. S's own visits are reads only (96 GETs, no re-send, measured in the box log), so waiting does nothing. If Stuart re-sends, it re-arms in place under the same anchor id, with no writes by us; the fee (~0.2 test ADA) comes from demo's wallet, which has a plain coin. Evidence: fleet/briefs_staged/2026-11-25_AA8_q_method.txt. Link: https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-772 (Override of the prior-ruling gate: every match shares only 'demo', 'anchor' or 'stuart'; the closest, secuura-stuart-ks772-anchor-row-question-1029 = a, was a one-off reply about a different anchor; this morning's demo-pk card was WITHDRAWN on your note, not ruled.)

default_action: If you don't answer: nothing is posted, the seat wraps, and the 48-hour reminder re-raises it. NOT offered (forbidden classes): a database status reset on demo, or any route using a credential we were not given.
